clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire's Town Hall, Sirra Von'Indi deciphers Abercrombie's cryptic note. As the resident scholar puts quill to paper, dread settles over the room, and the hermit's words hint at danger.

Sirra Von'Indi has the note Abercrombie sent from his seclusion. The scholar aids the Night Watch and Darkshire's leaders, and needs only a short time to decipher the message. He does not yet know what horrors its words conceal.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm almost finished translating that note. If you come back in a few moments I should be done.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The air grows heavy, as if a thick, black curtain is drawn over the land...
